visualCharacteristics: A fact card beside the channel text showing the channel logo, channel number with option glyphs, labelled fact lists and chevron links underneath.
contentPattern: Rows are classified by content: a picture row for the channel logo; a label | icon notation row for the channel number and glyphs (e.g. Kanaal 003 | :hd: :ziggo-go:); label | list rows for fact groups (e.g. Onderdeel van: | Kabel TV, TV Standard); and a list of links for the links under the card. Author it in the same section as the channel text.
usage: Use on channel detail pages to show a channel logo, number, package membership and options beside the channel description.
reuseGuidance: Reuse on every channel detail page, keeping it in the same section as the channel text so the two-column layout applies.
